title: POST /v1/parse request (document-intelligence.v1)
description: Wire encoding is multipart/form-data with exactly two parts: `metadata`, a JSON string (UTF-8, bounded by max_metadata_bytes) conforming to the request-metadata grammar with `mediaType` required and drawn from the admitted media catalog; and `file`, the opaque binary upload bounded by max_upload_bytes. The optional X-Operation-Generation header carries a 32-character lowercase hex token that must equal metadata.operationGeneration when both are present.

mediaType.description: Enum lists the canonical Increment-3 catalog. Profiles may admit additional capability-driven media types; the validator enforces the admitted set, not this literal list.

languageHint.description: Enum lists the canonical Increment-3 languages; profiles may admit additional candidate languages.

file.description: Opaque binary upload part. Maximum size is the configured max_upload_bytes limit (default 52428800).
